rapport_notes: Warm and patient through an unusual two-quote request, clearly enjoyed problem-solving with the customer.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I kinda dive into the. Were there any other, just top of mind, concerns or just questions that you might have. I just wanna make sure that I make sure I hit those."
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Dug into the bed set, sofa, and especially the two glass-front China cabinets the customer was worried about across many turns, then built two parallel quotes on request
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "I know that you mentioned these two china cabinets, we also have our no worry damage coverage... covers up to $2,000" / "you only pay for the time you use"

top_strength: Gave the customer exactly what she asked for -- two clean parallel quotes (full move vs. cabinets-only) -- while circling back to directly address her stated worry about the glass-front china cabinets with the damage-coverage line.
coaching_note: Never explicitly asked for the close or mentioned rate-lock-at-booking language -- understandable since the customer wasn't ready to commit, but worth building in the ask as a habit for when she calls back.
